extra.message: User-controlled 'searchText' (from req.query.searchText via /api/search and req.body.searchText via /search) is concatenated directly into a SQL query string passed to db.all(). This allows SQL injection, e.g. searchText="' OR '1'='1" modifies the query logic.

The 'searchText' value (sourced from req.body.searchText in routes/search.js) is rendered using Pug's unescaped '!=' operator, so HTML/script characters in user input are emitted without escaping, enabling reflected cross-site scripting.
Hardcoded admin credential 'S3cr37P@$$w0rD!' is written into the user table during bootstrap. Hardcoded passwords are a security risk if this database is used in a deployed environment.
